sloka: रामम् च एव महात्मानम् लक्ष्मणम् च पुनः पुनः ।प्रीताः च तुष्टुवुः सर्वे तादृशे तत्र वर्तिनि ॥४-२६-४०॥
transliteration: rāmam ca eva mahātmānam lakṣmaṇam ca punaḥ punaḥ ।prītāḥ ca tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve tādṛśe tatra vartini ॥4-26-40॥

translations.english: As Sugriva and Angada were installed, all the monkeys were highly pleased and praised the noblehearted Rama and Lakshmana again and again.
